task: Gate C, task C1: certify the six common-base roots (lambda = 0) of the exact square system F(z) = [p(z)-p0; vee((S-S^T)/2)] on the exp69 frozen model; box, B, eta, kappa, strict margins, false-root exclusion, z_j != 0, pairwise disjointness
spec: study/collab/GPT_GATE_C_SPEC_20261017.md sections 4, 5, 6 and task C1 of 7
boundary: C1 only: six root boxes at the base point; no segment or path certification, no permutation claims, and no certification flags beyond the per-root boxes

backend.name: exact rational interval arithmetic over Python fractions.Fraction endpoints (complex rectangular intervals)
backend.rounding: none; interval endpoints are exact rationals, products take the min/max of the four endpoint products, reciprocals use exact rational inversion, every comparison is exact
backend.precision: exact (unbounded rational arithmetic); no floating-point value enters any certificate constant
floating_inputs: box centres exp(i q_seed) computed in IEEE double only to select the box, then frozen as exact binary rationals (spec section 4)
B = numpy double inverse of the float Jacobian at centre0, frozen as exact binary rationals (spec section 5)

system.product_order: FK = L1 A1 L2 A2 ... L6 A6, A_j(z_j) the z-rotation with c_j=(z_j+1/z_j)/2, s_j=(z_j-1/z_j)/(2i)
system.realification: x = (Re z1, Im z1, ..., Re z6, Im z6) in R^12; f = (Re F1, Im F1, ..., Re F6, Im F6)
system.jacobian_blocks: Df[2k,2j]=Re J_kj, Df[2k,2j+1]=-Im J_kj, Df[2k+1,2j]=Im J_kj, Df[2k+1,2j+1]=Re J_kj (F holomorphic in z)
system.false_root_exclusion: |trace S - 3| < 4 on the whole box plus z_j != 0; S^T S = I and det S = 1 identically, so a skew-free S with trace 3 is S = I
system.contraction: T(x) = x - B f(x); eta = ||B f(c)||_inf exactly; kappa_i >= sup_{x in X} ||row_i(I - B Df(x))||_1 by interval evaluation of the analytic Jacobian; strict margin r - eta - kappa_i r > 0 and kappa < 1 give a strict contraction of X into its interior and hence exactly one regular root in X
system.radius_policy: uniform certification radius r = 2^-40 with the comfort test kappa < 1/2 and margin >= r/2; if it fails, larger radii are retried honestly and the failure is recorded, never loosened
